title: Rose-derived extracellular vesicle-like particles enable anti-melanogenesis by suppressing the key melanogenic pathway in skin cells.
authors: Zhou, Sirui; Li, Huijing; Yang, Ying; Zeng, Weiying; Li, Dongxiao; Qiu, Tianxin; Lu, Weiguo; Zhao, Kewei
journal: Extracellular vesicles and circulating nucleic acids
one_liner_zh: 该文研究玫瑰来源囊泡抑制黑色素生成，涉及MITF转录因子与TRP-1蛋白的分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是皮肤色素调控而非TF-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Aim: Abnormal skin pigmentation is not merely a common cosmetic concern but is also associated with pigmentation disorders and an elevated risk of malignant lesions such as melanoma. To overcome the adverse effects of existing antimelanogenic agents, we developed rose-derived extracellular vesicle-like particles (RS-EVLP) as a novel and biocompatible melanogenesis inhibitor. Methods: RS-EVLP were isolated from roses and characterized by transmission electron microscopy and mass spectrometry. Their anti-melanogenic effects were evaluated in B16 cells via melanin content and tyrosinase activity assays. Molecular mechanisms were investigated using molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis. In vivo efficacy was assessed in a zebrafish model, followed by a clinical trial in human volunteers. Results: RS-EVLP exhibited a bilayer nanostructure (50-150 nm) and contained natural anti-melanogenic components, including luteolin and procyanidin B3. They showed high binding affinity to microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF) and tyrosinase-related protein 1 (TRP-1). In B16 cells, RS-EVLP dose-dependently reduced melanin content and tyrosinase activity by downregulating MITF and the transcription of tyrosinase (TYR)/TRP-1/TRP-2 enzyme system. In zebrafish, RS-EVLP reduced melanin spot area by 24% +/- 17.5%. Clinical studies confirmed that a 5% RS-EVLP formulation progressively enhanced skin brightness as skin penetration efficiency increased. Conclusion: RS-EVLP overcomes the limitations in bioavailability and toxicity associated with traditional synthetic whitening agents, offering a promising natural alternative for developing whitening cosmeceuticals.
abstract_zh: 目的：异常皮肤色素沉着不仅是一个常见的 cosmetic 问题，还与色素沉着障碍及黑色素瘤等恶性病变风险升高相关。为克服现有抗黑色素生成剂的不良反应，我们开发了玫瑰来源的细胞外囊泡样颗粒（RS-EVLP）作为一种新型且生物相容的黑色素生成抑制剂。方法：从玫瑰中分离 RS-EVLP，并通过透射电子显微镜和质谱法进行表征。在 B16 细胞中通过黑色素含量和酪氨酸酶活性测定评估其抗黑色素生成效果。利用分子对接、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和表面等离子体共振 (surface plasmon resonance, SPR) 分析研究分子机制。在斑马鱼模型中评估体内疗效，随后在人类志愿者中进行临床试验。结果：RS-EVLP 呈现双层纳米结构（50-150 nm），并含有天然抗黑色素生成成分，包括木犀草素和原花青素 B3。它们对微phthalmia相关转录因子 (microphthalmia-associated transcription factor, MITF) 和酪氨酸酶相关蛋白 1 (tyrosinase-related protein 1, TRP-1) 表现出高结合亲和力。在 B16 细胞中，RS-EVLP 通过下调 MITF 及酪氨酸酶 (tyrosinase, TYR)/TRP-1/TRP-2 酶系统的转录，剂量依赖性地降低黑色素含量和酪氨酸酶活性。在斑马鱼中，RS-EVLP 将黑色素斑点面积减少了 24% ± 17.5%。临床研究证实，5% RS-EVLP 配方随着皮肤渗透效率的提高，逐步增强皮肤亮度。结论：RS-EVLP 克服了传统合成美白剂在生物利用度和毒性方面的局限性，为开发美白药妆品提供了一种有前景的天然替代方案。
